options.label: Auto
options.meaning: Enable the existing profile routing policy on the active Claude host CLI. Each Agent/Task call still launches at most the one sub-agent requested by the caller; the hook may replace its requested model with the first allowed and usable Claude candidate. Codex exposes no equivalent verified sub-agent hook and its candidates remain non-selectable in Auto.

options.label: Dupliqué
options.meaning: Compatibility/inheritance mode. Preserve the model selected by the caller or CLI and launch only the requested sub-agent. Never duplicate work and never fan out.

delegation_mode.help: Auto choisit le modèle selon les profils sur le CLI Claude hôte; Codex reste non sélectionnable en Auto. Dupliqué hérite du choix du CLI/appelant; ce nom ne signifie jamais deux exécutions.

deferred_controls.reason: No configurable runtime semantic; delegation mode never controls fan-out.
Existing timeouts are fixed and path-specific, not one safe user setting.
No measured comparable score or resolver input exists.
Profile/general fallback already exists; a second fallback would contradict it.
ActionBroker security confirmation is policy, not personality; no weakening setting.
Overlaps response_verbosity until distinct runtime semantics exist.

stack_projection.compatibility: Sans voice_architecture, voice_arch choisit legacy/continuous_brain et voice_stack choisit la pile; les champs de cette pile pilotent le runtime.
stack_projection.explicit: Avec voice_architecture, l'architecture et ses modèles viennent du bloc versionné. Le runtime dérive sa pile (OpenAI actuellement), consomme les réglages transport correspondants et conserve les autres piles inactives sans les effacer.
stack_projection.model_precedence: Les modèles du bloc voice_architecture remplacent les champs model de compatibilité; les réglages audio/VAD/transcription de la pile dérivée restent actifs.

invariants: Reading settings never mutates persisted data.
Missing routing state never silently enables Auto.

Saving unrelated settings preserves unknown and inactive legacy fields.
Both delegation modes affect model selection only, never sub-agent call count.

future_expected_events.code_scope: The owning CliSettingsError, RoutingError, SelfDevError or AgentBehaviorError supplies its stable code. slice_02_stable_codes lists only codes introduced by this Slice, not the pre-existing validator registries.

observability_test_contract.correlation: Use tool_use_id for each delegation decision. Settings save remains correlated to RuntimeJournal session until an HTTP request correlation id exists; do not fabricate one.
observability_test_contract.recovery: Invalid saves are atomic and keep prior settings and active-agent prompt memory. Prompt edits validate the same combined bound before their writer. Routing hook internal failure preserves caller/CLI choice and emits routing_hook_failed. No automatic retry or fan-out.
observability_test_contract.temporary_probes: None. Add TEMP probes only in an active debug session and remove them before closure.
